## Science

*Your scholars search for knowledge.*

Discover cards 46–53. Cards 54–63 go to the back of your box, behind your other undiscovered cards: only effects discover them.

You may now use the stickers of this foundation ({{science}}, {{iron}}, {{goods}} and a tab). Science ({{science}}) is a new resource.
texts.237:
## Church

*Establish the church as a power to be reckoned with. Build the mighty cathedral, educate scholars in your monasteries and lay the foundation for science.*

Discover cards 65–70. Cards 71–87 go to the back of your box, behind your other undiscovered cards: only effects discover them. Do not lose the Mountain Construction (70) before discovering the Archbishops.

You may now use the stickers of this foundation (blessings, {{science}}, {{wood}} and {{passif}} Stay in play). Herbs ({{herb}}) and science ({{science}}) are new resources.
texts.261:
## Romance

*Knights and ladies, quests and courtly love.* At least 4 knights are strongly recommended.

Discover cards 89–97. Cards 98–105 go to the back of your box, behind your other undiscovered cards: only effects discover them.

You may now use the stickers of this foundation (+2 and +5 {{glory}}, Knight, {{passif}} Stay in play, Starts in play and the 6 scarves). A knight wearing a lady's scarf is her knight.
